# Tuiport

> Build real SSH apps with OpenTUI, run the same container locally or on Cloudflare, and connect from any terminal with ordinary SSH.

Canonical site: https://tuiport.coey.dev
Source: https://github.com/acoyfellow/tuiport
License: MIT

## Documentation

- [Tutorial](https://tuiport.coey.dev/tutorial): Deploy the Cloudflare application and connect a public SSH hostname.
- [How-to guides](https://tuiport.coey.dev/how-to): Customize the OpenTUI app, authentication, relay token, and domains.
- [Reference](https://tuiport.coey.dev/reference): Worker routes, ports, resources, configuration, and lifecycle.
- [Explanation](https://tuiport.coey.dev/explanation): Why direct SSH currently needs a narrow TCP-to-WebSocket relay.

## Architecture

OpenSSH → Cloudflare Spectrum → stateless TCP relay → authenticated WebSocket → Worker → Durable Object → Cloudflare Container → @opentui/ssh.

The relay forwards encrypted SSH bytes and holds no application state. It is designed to disappear when native inbound TCP can route to a Worker or Container binding.
